propositions: rebar hardcodes DC comment ceiling at 32767 chars, but Jira DC's jira.text.field.character.limit is admin-configurable (0 to 2147483647); comments exceeding the hardcoded value but within the admin-configured limit are silently truncated
comments longer than the compiled default 32767 but shorter than a raised admin-configured ceiling should not be truncated when the ceiling is configured upward
sanitize_comment previously reused the description fitter fit_outbound, creating a latent trap where future changes to description fitting could silently retarget comment truncation
the DC comment ceiling must be user-configurable via configuration, defaulting to 32767 with provenance documented as jira.text.field.character.limit from Jira's jpm.xml and JRASERVER-28519
comment truncation must be decoupled from the description fitter so changes to description fitting rules cannot affect comment handling
readability of /rest/api/2/application-properties by rebar's non-admin PAT is admin-only (403 confirmed by live measurement), so auto-discovery is not viable and configuration is the required remedy
